Q: How to signal a multithreaded worker pool at very high throughput? A:

Good question. I avoid atomics, so I might not be the best person to comment on this, but it seems that the amount of computational work you're doing in a single step is insufficient for performance improvements using multithreading. Your single worker thread solution significantly outperforms your multithreaded solution. It looks like you only have a few thousand CPU instructions to perform in each step. For such cases, I would recommend abandoning multithreading and just try to optimise your single threaded worker code by using techniques like branchless programming and SIMD. Multithreading has an overhead which is what I think is your problem here.

Q: NativePHP: Running application in the background A:

تشغيل NativePHP في الخلفية على الموبايل

الوضع الحالي: لا يوجد دعم كامل لتشغيل التطبيق بشكل دائم في الخلفية عند إغلاقه أو إطفاء الشاشة، بسبب قيود أنظمة iOS وAndroid.

الحل البديل (عندما يكون التطبيق نشطًا):

function checkState() {
    fetch('/cgi/ch_ref.php')
        .then(response => response.text())
        .then(data => { /* معالجة البيانات */ });
}
setInterval(checkState, 30000);

عند إغلاق التطبيق:

الكود داخل التطبيق يتوقف تمامًا

الحل: تنفيذ المهام على الخادم (Cron/Queue) واستعلام التطبيق عند إعادة الفتح

إعدادات الخلفية في NativePHP v3 (محدودة):

iOS (config/nativephp.php):

'ios' => [
    'background_modes' => ['fetch', 'processing', 'remote-notification']
]

Q: Is codeigniter 3 compatible with php version 8? A:

According to the changelog here https://codeigniter.com/userguide3/changelog.html from version 3.1.12, CI3 has been updated for PHP 8.0 and 8.1 compatibility. The latest release (current version) is now 3.1.13

However, you may still run into small issues that they missed (e.g. someone posted an issue with the Pagination library here on SO last week that seemed to be caused by PHP 8 - How do I make CI Pagination first page url segment always appear? First page pagination with search query has an error message ).
